TVEC patch notes
New features, improvements and fixes that affect your TVEC experience, from newest to oldest.
26 October 2026
Redesigned missions and shop
The Missions page now reads at a glance: “To do” and “Completed” tabs, one row per mission with its reward, how it is checked and the action button. Your bio link copies in one click.
The cosmetics shop now has a category bar that stays visible while scrolling, a “My items” filter and a compact header with your balance. No more scrolling through the whole page to find a theme or badge.
26 October 2026
PayPal email confirmation
Saving your PayPal email now shows a confirmation and clears previous errors. Connection or email address issues are no longer presented as a 2FA verification failure.
26 October 2026
Entries and sales workspace
The sales workspace now centers on daily priorities, sponsor tracking, tasks and a searchable library. Cases open in a side panel that protects unsaved changes.
The sales workspace help button now has a clearer question mark and a larger click target.
A “?” button opens a guided tour of the sales workspace, with simple explanations, highlighted elements and steps you can revisit any time.
The entries table keeps avatars, actions and analytics, with sorting by views, score and date. Each editor’s three most-viewed edits remain expandable.
On mobile, entries now show as readable cards with no sideways scrolling: views, likes and edit count under the username, score and prize only when they exist, Watch button and TikTok link side by side. The “not the podium” note fits on one line and expands when needed.
Signing in and linking your account with Discord work again.
TVEC profile TikTok teasers and the “Like & comment on our teaser” mission now also accept photo posts (carousels).
A badge in the menu flags new missions, and a new “Like our video” mission earns Trophies.
The sales workspace is now in the Staff section. Button hover contrast is fixed in dark mode.
25 October 2026
Clearer contest tracking
A dedicated sales workspace brings together assigned and shared cases, sponsor follow-ups, tasks, private resources and TVEC figures. The owner assigns the role and controls sharing.
The owner can track referrer and ambassador rankings, including attributed registrations, linked TikTok accounts and recruited participants.
Eligible editors with more than 10,000 TikTok followers can receive a one-time ambassador invitation when linking their account, according to their email preferences.
Lives can include a short description, shown on the banner, event card and email reminders.
For top-three-total contests, entries are grouped by editor: combined views of the three most-viewed edits, expandable details and your pinned summary. Older contest rules are unchanged.
25 October 2026
Create your team from 100 Trophies
Creating a team now costs 100 Trophies instead of 1,000. Other requirements and the renaming cost are unchanged.
25 October 2026
Contest results live on Discord
Scheduled lives are announced at the top of the contests page. The Discord link is available before the live starts, from both the banner and the contest page.
Enable the bell on the contest page for an email when the live starts. Participants also receive a reminder one hour beforehand, subject to their email preferences.
The owner can schedule, reschedule and cancel a live and see the number of enabled alerts. Rescheduling or cancelling stops the previous reminders.
Shared links to contests awaiting results also load the current version of the site.
25 October 2026
More resilient loading
When a stylesheet is temporarily unavailable, the site waits and retries before reloading. If the issue persists, a manual retry remains available, without a reload loop.
The error screen now matches TVEC’s dark style, with retry and home actions available even if the site’s styles fail to load.
24 October 2026
Public TikTok video verification
Fixed some rejections incorrectly reporting public videos as private or unavailable. Account ownership and publication-date checks remain mandatory.
24 October 2026
New menu, new account settings and entry from 10 followers
The menu is organised by use, Play, Social, Earn and My space, and always stays open: Teams and community contests are visible without expanding anything.
New “Go to…” button at the top of the menu, also with Ctrl+K: type a few letters (team, shop, withdraw…) to open any page.
New What’s new page, with a badge until you have seen it: the latest features, each with a button to try it.
Badges in the menu show what arrived since your last visit: team requests and invitations, community contests, referrals and winnings.
Your TikTok video isn’t public yet (scheduled, private or under review)? The site tells you clearly and checks it again on its own for 48 hours: your entry is added as soon as it goes public.
You now only need a linked TikTok account with at least 10 followers to enter a contest or vote, instead of 50.
On mobile, the bottom bar shows Contests, Entries, Profile and Wallet. The “More” button opens every page in a grid, with a search, and lets you pick the pages in your bar and their position, with a reset to the default shortcuts.
Profile settings: the “Account & Data” section shows your username, email, account creation date and sign-in methods. You can link or remove Google and Discord, change or add a password, and change your email address with a confirmation link.
New settings: “Security & devices” lists your trusted devices and lets you sign out everywhere; “Preferences” groups language, theme and sounds; plus “Contests I like” and “Privacy”, where you can hide your earnings on your public profile.
The editor and sponsor guides now use the dark theme and show real screenshots of the site at every step, in your language.
20 October 2026
More reliable entry videos and team help
Teams: you can now ask to join a private team. A team officer accepts or declines the request.
Announcements: official TVEC news now also shows up in your notifications. One click opens the full announcement.
Display: the custom theme and neon settings are readable in dark mode, a team member’s action menu is no longer cut off, and the Community section now comes before Rewards in the menu.
Teams: recruiters of a private or on-request team can create an invitation link valid for 7 days that lets people join directly. A received invitation can now be accepted from the team page.
Teams: a “?” button explains what a team is, how it earns points, the roles and the season rewards.
Opening an entry now plays the video with TikTok’s official player, instead of a blank screen when TikTok was limiting loads. An “Open on TikTok” link is always available.
20 October 2026
The big update: community contests, teams, Public’s Choice and cheaper Trophies
Community contests: any editor with a linked TikTok account can host their own contest, for glory, for Trophies or with a cash prize pot. The community votes.
Public’s Choice award: on contests that enable it, editors vote for their favourite edit and the most voted one wins the award.
Teams: create or join a team with its own crest, chat, weekly goals and season leaderboard.
Referrals: earn 10% of your referrals’ winnings on their first 3 winning contests, paid by TVEC. Your referrals keep 100% of their winnings.
Ambassador program: 10% of your recruits’ winnings, and a contest in your name at 100 verified recruits.
Missions: earn free Trophies by completing missions (add a link, follow, comment).
Trophy prices have dropped massively: 4 times more Trophies for the same price, 2,000 Trophies for €4.99, enough for a legendary decoration. Packs also have new names.
Shop: click a decoration to see it larger, with a preview on your own profile.
Halloween: limited edition in the shop until 2 November, with 12 profile decorations, themes, badges and a title. Yours to keep afterwards.
To enter a contest or vote when cash is at stake, you now need a linked TikTok account with at least 50 followers.
Sponsors: new decreasing fee for new sponsors, from 30% on the first contest down to 15% from the tenth. Existing sponsors keep their current pricing.
The site is noticeably faster, on mobile and desktop.
The terms of service and privacy policy have been updated for these new features.
13 October 2026
Contest deadline changes are announced
When a live contest’s deadline changes, all editors receive an in-site notification with the new deadline in Paris time and UTC, and access to the contest.
12 October 2026
New TVEC icon
The new purple logo on a dark background appears in browser tabs and mobile shortcuts.
12 October 2026
Discord login return fixed
Returning from Discord to tvec.gg resumes login instead of leaving you on a text-only page. Security checks remain enabled.
11 October 2026
Recognizable contest links
Contest links now show the cashprize followed by the track name, for example /contest/€1500funkcalor. Existing links still work.
11 October 2026
Easier sharing and a clearer menu
Every contest page now has a Share button, including when logged out. On mobile it opens your phone’s share menu; elsewhere you can copy the link.
The public mobile menu now uses the TVEC logo and the site’s dark design. Login and signup buttons are easier to read.
This page brings together new features and fixes that affect your TVEC experience.
11 October 2026
Shared links open the right pages
Public links no longer send you to the old pre-launch page, even on your first visit.
Contests and profiles viewed while logged out use the dark theme. Contest loading now shows the TVEC loader, without the old menu or light footer while you wait.
11 October 2026
Shorter addresses on tvec.gg
English is the default language on tvec.gg: new English links no longer use /en. The French homepage is at tvec.gg/fr.
French pages use a translated name when one exists, such as /parrainage. When the name is identical in both languages, the French version uses /fr.
11 October 2026
Upcoming contests are easier to follow
The upcoming contests tab shows a count so you can spot what is coming next.
Authorized organizers can edit or delete a Next Drop. A teaser can contain a single MP3 without a poll.
MP3 previews can be up to 20 MB, with a maximum duration of 5 minutes. Errors explain more clearly when a preview exceeds the allowed duration.
10 October 2026
More control over sponsor rewards
The sponsor brief lets you add honorable mentions to the prize distribution.
Exact prize amounts you enter are preserved, without forced rounding from percentage-based distribution.
9 October 2026
Clearer explanations of prizes
Help in the Rewards tab explains jury ranking, virality prizes and honorable mentions. Ranking by views is not the official jury podium.
